text: 据中国财政部网站，2026年10月20日至21日，第33届亚太经合组织（APEC）财长会在中国香港特别行政区举行。财政部部长蓝佛安作为会议主席主持会议并致辞，副部长廖岷代表中方发言。2026年APEC高官会主席陈旭出席会议并发言。香港特别行政区行政长官李家超出席欢迎晚宴。来自APEC成员经济体、APEC观察员以及有关国际组织等共300余名代表参会。
text_en: According to the website of China's Ministry of Finance, the 33rd APEC Finance Ministers' Meeting was held in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of China on October 20-21, 2026. Minister of Finance Lan Fo'an chaired the meeting as chairman and delivered a speech, while Vice Minister Liao Min spoke on behalf of the Chinese side. Chen Xu, chairman of the 2026 APEC Senior Officials' Meeting, attended the meeting and delivered remarks. John Lee, Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, attended the welcome dinner. More than 300 representatives from APEC member economies, APEC observers, and relevant international organizations attended the meeting.
